description: Returns what has actually been DONE on this site through a key rather than a browser: keys created and used, abilities run, and requests refused. Newest first, cursor-paginated with `before`. It is a record, not a guard — it names the key, never the person. `coverage` is the one field to read before trusting an empty list: it says whether this WordPress can see ability runs at all, so "nothing here" can be told apart from "nothing is being watched". Pair it with read-clients, which answers the other half — who FETCHED pages, signed in or not.

before.description: Pagination cursor: pass the previous page’s `cursor` for older rows.

name: agentimus-read-agent-access

coverage.description: Whether ability runs can be watched here at all — read this before treating an empty list as "nothing happened".

cursor.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; empty at the end.

credName.description: Which key, by the name it was given.

hits.description: How many times this same event has happened.

kind.description: What happened: a key created or used, an ability run, a request refused.

subject.description: What it acted on — the ability name, for an ability run.

user.description: The WordPress login the key acts as.

hasAbilities.description: Whether this WordPress exposes the Abilities API.

maxRows.description: The hard row cap; the oldest go first when it binds.

thirdParty.description: Whether abilities from OTHER plugins are visible too, or only Agentimus’s own.

total.description: Events on record, which may exceed the page returned.

unseen.description: Events the owner has not looked at yet.

title: Read the agent access record
